question: which toolchain builds the V26 ARM image, given that the operator's toolchain is Windows-only and the assistant's shells are Linux
scope: offline reproduction experiment only; no flash, no COM, no RF, nothing written into any milestone directory

operator_toolchain.distribution: GNU Tools for Arm Embedded Processors 7-2018-q2-update
operator_toolchain.recorded_in_prior_manifests: arm-none-eabi-gcc.exe (GNU Tools for Arm Embedded Processors 7-2018-q2-update) 7.3.1 20180622 (release) [ARM/embedded-7-branch revision 261907]
operator_toolchain.reason: device_bash is a Linux VM on the operator's machine and cannot execute Windows binaries; the cloud container has no ARM toolchain at all

computer_use_not_a_route.detail: desktop control grants terminals and IDEs the click tier, where typing and key presses are blocked, so a Windows shell cannot be driven to run the build

arm_official_linux_distribution.evidence: https://developer.arm.com and https://armkeil.blob.core.windows.net both return HTTP 403 from the egress proxy after CONNECT, from the device VM
arm_official_linux_distribution.consequence: the distribution that would carry the identical bundled newlib cannot be obtained; a third-party mirror was deliberately not used, because its contents could not be authenticated against a hash known to be ARM's

linux_toolchain_obtained.sha256_verified_against: the publisher's own manifest in the npm package @xpack-dev-tools/arm-none-eabi-gcc@7.3.1-1.2.2
linux_toolchain_obtained.version_string: arm-none-eabi-gcc (xPack GNU ARM Embedded GCC, 64-bit) 7.3.1 20180622 (release) [ARM/embedded-7-branch revision 261907]
linux_toolchain_obtained.installed_at: device VM home, outside the repository and outside every connected folder

reproduction_experiment.method: V25 was rebuilt from its own committed sources with the Linux toolchain, using the exact flag list, include derivation, source list and link command of ctx1_rx_admission_v25/tools/build.py; nothing was written into the repository and the frozen V25 build_manifest.json was not touched
reproduction_experiment.cause: not embedded paths. The project's own sources contain no __FILE__, __DATE__ or __TIME__, and APP_ERROR_CHECK expands to app_error_handler_bare because DEBUG is not defined, so no source path reaches the image. A bss difference cannot come from string paths either. The remaining explanation is the bundled C library: xPack links its own newlib build rather than the one in ARM's 7-2018-q2-update distribution.
reproduction_experiment.conclusion: the GCC version, build date and branch revision match the lineage exactly, but the toolchain distribution and its libc do not, so a Linux build is functionally equivalent and byte-different

decision.chosen: build V26 with the Linux xPack toolchain, and record this deviation in the V26 build manifest
decision.authority: the operator asked the assistant to solve the build rather than hand it back
consequence_to_state_in_every_v26_manife: the image is not bit-comparable with the V17 to V25 lineage
the compiler version, date and revision do match
the difference measured on a V25 reproduction is text +568 and bss +12
decision.operator_alternative: running tools/build.py on Windows with the existing 7-2018-q2-update toolchain still yields a lineage-identical image, should byte comparability be wanted for a specific gate
decision.unchanged_policy: the operator alone flashes the dongle, manually; building is not flashing
